definition: This dimension controls the maximum number of items or weight a player can carry in their inventory, varying from highly restrictive limits to more generous allowances. Games may implement different capacity limits to influence gameplay pacing, exploration strategy, and resource management.
exclusion_criteria: Games with no inventory management system.
Games that allow infinite item capacity without any consequences.
inclusion_criteria: Games that impose strict inventory limits requiring careful item selection.
Games that allow for larger inventory space but may include weight penalties.
title: Inventory Capacity Limit Variation
